_doc: T-1396: hostile skills and agents for fm lib's source indexer. test_lib_hostile writes each body to its path in a scratch git repo ({c*N} is the character c, N times), adds the links (symlinks are made at test time: fixtures stay text files), and expects each item's quarantine reason to contain `expect`; an empty `expect` is a clean item that must be indexed and searchable; an `absent` one (a symlink that is no skill or agent) must not be in the index at all.
